name.baseName: Ventilation system, centralized, average for 1 m3/(h m2)

dataSetInformation.common:generalComment: Production of a ventilation system for a building with a specific air flow rate of 1 m3/h per m2 heated gross floor area. The reference value of the inventory is 1 m2 heated gross floor area. The inventory is based on average data of 4 office buildings, 3 schools and 3 residential care homes with a total heated gross floor area of 61719 m2 and a total nominal air flow of 302190 m3/h, specific weight of the components: 4.16 kg/m2, including average components for air handling units, ducts including insulation, air valves, roof-hoods, dampers, fire dampers, silencers. The data represent a ductwork mainly made of galvanized steel and includes air handling units mainly with heat recovery and a nominal air flow rate of 5'000-20'000 m3/h per unit. No ground heat exchanger is included.; UUID: 4666b564-d9d8-3314-8d75-21ca13f9234a

technology.technologyDescriptionAndIncludedProcesse:
Typical technology, materials and components used for ventilation systems in commercial and public buildings

# Included processes
Materials used for the production. Energy use for the different production steps and for heating the production building. Transport of raw materials to the plant. Estimation for infrastructure of the production site included.
